pages.text:
{{Target Bird Merch|image1=BirdDoorMat.webp|caption-image1=A doormat with three birds on it.|target.com_title=1'6"x2'6" Christmas Bundled Birds Coir Doormat White - Wondershop™|target.com_description=Welcome your guests to your home in festive style with the Christmas Bundled Birds Coir Doormat from Wondershop™. This rectangular doormat features the phrase "Warm Wishes" and three birds wearing winter gear to add a seasonal vibe to your front door. This doormat helps keep your space clean by clearing dirt and debris from shoes at the door, while the latex backing helps prevent it from slipping or sliding. Best of all, you can simply shake it out to keep it looking fresh and clean.|color=Brown, white|type=[[Merchandise]]|subtype=Doormat|collection=[[Christmas 2024 Releases|Christmas 2024]]|holiday/season=[[Christmas Releases|Christmas]]|year=[[2024 Releases|2024]]|release_date=October 2024}}
This is a doormat with a picture of three birds on it, along with the phrase "warm wishes."

pages.title: 10pc Featherly Friends 2025 Anniversary Collection Christmas Bird Figurine Set - Wondershop™
pages.text:
{{Target Bird|title1=|image1=10pcAnniversary2025.webp|caption-image1=|target.com_title=10pc Featherly Friends 2025 Anniversary Collection Christmas Bird Figurine Set - Wondershop™|target.com_description=Take your holiday decor to the next level with this 10-Piece Featherly Friends 2025 Anniversary Collection Christmas Bird Figurine Set from Wondershop™. Made from polyester, this set includes ten bird figurines with detailed designs dressed in vibrant attire and party hats, adorably capturing the warmth and whimsy of the seasonal celebrations. Display them as a set or showcase them separately on your mantel, shelf or tabletop as part of a winter scene.|color=|type=[[Sets|Set]]|release=(leave blank)|collection=[[Christmas 2025 Releases|Christmas 2025]]|holiday/season=[[Christmas Releases|Christmas]]|year=[[2025 Releases|2025]]|release_date=September 2025}}This is a set of full-size birds. Eight of them are re-releases of birds from previous years: [[Harkin|Harkin (2022)]], [[Apple|Apple (2023)]], [[Crinkle|Crinkle (2023)]], [[Dia de los Muertos Releases|Cantante (2017)]], [[Spella|Spella (2020)]], [[Easter Releases|Stormy (2020)]], [[Goldy|Goldy (2019)]], and [[Scoop|Scoop (2023)]]. One new bird named [[Aurum]] is also included. Each bird has a foot tag with their name on one side and "2025 Anniversary" on the other as well as gold stitching on the underside of their body that says "Hatched" and their original year. The rereleased birds also each have new, gold detailing.

The set also includes a cake & mini bird accessory, as well as a "Hooray" banner and three miniature disco balls.<gallery>

pages.title: 10pc Featherly Friends™ 2024 Reunion Collection Christmas Bird Figurine Set - Wondershop™
pages.text:
{{Target Bird Set|image1=ReunionCollection.webp|target.com_title=10pc Featherly Friends™ 2024 Reunion Collection Christmas Bird Figurine Set - Wondershop™|color=Green, white, red, blue, brown, silver|accessories_in_set=Christmas Tree With Presents|collection=[[Christmas 2024 Releases|Christmas 2024]]|season=[[Christmas Releases|Christmas]]|year=[[2024 Releases|2024]]|release_date=September 2024|birds_in_set=[[Brook]], [[Bells]], [[Tinsel (Christmas 2021)]], [[Powell]], [[Cheeryble]], [[Peary]], [[Piper]], [[Roller]], and [[Mormor]].|target.com_description=Set up a festive scene in your home with the 10-Piece Featherly Friends™ 2024 Reunion Collection Christmas Bird Figurine Set from Wondershop™. This Featherly Friends bird figurine set includes Roller from 2016, Piper from 2017, Peary from 2018, Cheeryble from 2019 and more along with a Christmas tree figurine to help showcase their reunion during the holiday season. Made of soft fabric, the pieces create an elegant display on a tabletop or any other flat surface indoors.}}

This is a set of full-size birds. Eight of them are re-releases of Christmas birds from previous years: [[Brook|Brook (2023)]], [[Bells|Bells (2022)]], [[Tinsel (Christmas 2021)|Tinsel (2021)]], [[Powell|Powell (2020)]], [[Cheeryble|Cheeryble (2019)]], [[Peary|Peary (2018)]], [[Piper|Piper (2017)]], and [[Roller|Roller (2016)]]. One new bird named [[Mormor]] is also included. Each bird has a foot tag with their name on one side and "2024 Reunion" on the other as well as gold stitching on the underside of their body that says "Hatched" and their original year.

The set also includes a Christmas tree accessory with three presents.

{{Target Bird Set|image1=OrnamentSetSnowy.webp|caption-image1=A set of six white bird ornaments.|target.com_title=6pc Featherly Friends™ Fabric Bird Christmas Tree Ornament Set Snowy Whites - Wondershop™|color=White, gray, beige, pink|type=Ornament Set|birds_in_set=[[Ubuntu Ornament]], [[Heiwa Ornament]], [[Gezellig Ornament]], [[Mepak Ornament]], and two others|accessories_in_set=N/A|collection=[[Christmas 2024 Releases|Christmas 2024]]|season=[[Christmas Releases|Christmas]]|year=[[2024 Releases|2024]]|release_date=September 2024|target.com_description=Bring a cute touch of whimsy to your tree with this 6-Piece Featherly Friends™ Fabric Bird Christmas Tree Ornament Set from Wondershop™. pages.title: Alder
pages.text:
[[File:S-l160.jpg|thumb]]
Alder was a white bird with a refined sense of style, always wrapped in her gray wool peacoat lined with white fur. The fur-trimmed hood added an extra touch of elegance to her look, making her the go-to bird for winter fashion advice. Alder loved to help her friends pick out their winter outfits, ensuring everyone looked their best during the holiday season. Her gentle and sophisticated demeanor made her a beloved figure in the forest, where she often organized cozy gatherings to share her latest fashion tips.

Amber
pages.text:
[[File:Amber.jpg|thumb]]

== Fan Lore ==

Amber may look like a soft, fluffy gray bird, but she’s anything but delicate. Her white earmuffs and scarf only add to her charm, but beneath her cozy exterior is a strong and resilient bird. Amber is known for her determination, and when challenges arise, she’s always the first to step up and face them head-on. Whether it’s helping the other birds build nests or weathering the winter storms, Amber’s strength shines through.

pages.title: Aquilo
pages.text:
[[File:S-l1200-3.jpg|thumb]]
Aquilo was a spirited red bird known for his boundless energy and love for exploration. Dressed in a white fleece vest and a red and white striped hat with two points, Aquilo was always ready for an adventure. His enthusiasm for discovering new places in the forest was contagious, and he loved taking his friends along on his journeys. Whether scaling snowy peaks or venturing through the woods, Aquilo's adventurous spirit made every day in the forest exciting.

pages.title: Aspen
pages.text:
[[File:M 64fd086bacf46270a8f79995.jpg|thumb]]
Aspen in her white puffer coat with a brown fur-lined hood making her look like she was ready for any winter adventure. She loved exploring the snowy trails of the forest, her bright eyes always on the lookout for new paths to discover. Aspen quickly became friends with Camper and Scout, often joining them on their expeditions. Her presence added a sense of calm and confidence to their group, and together, they found some of the most breathtaking spots in the forest, perfect for their holiday gatherings.

pages.text:
[[File:S-l400-13.jpg|thumb]]

== Fan Lore ==

Bayham is a rugged red buffalo plaid bird, embodying the spirit of a mountain man. With his gray trapper hat and green knit scarf, he's always ready for the harsh winter weather. Bayham loves exploring the high altitudes of the forest, bringing back stories of the wilderness. His sturdy appearance and warm personality make him a respected figure among the other birds.

pages.title: Blazer
pages.text:
[[File:S-l1200.jpg|thumb]]
Blazer, a dapper little bird with a flair for fashion. He wore a bright red hat with a green pom-pom on the end and his signature gray tweed blazer. Underneath, he sported a cozy houndstooth red sweater that kept him warm as he flew through the wintry skies. Blazer was the heart of the group, always ready with a cheerful chirp and a warm smile. His colorful outfit made him stand out, and it wasn't long before the other animals of the forest looked to him as the leader of the Christmas birds.

pages.text:
[[File:S-l400-1.jpg|thumb]]
Not long after Blazer's arrival, Blizzard flew in on a gust of icy wind. She was a white bird, as pure as freshly fallen snow, with a serene beauty that captivated everyone she met. Blizzard was prepared for the cold, dressed in a luxurious brown fur hat and a matching scarf that wrapped around her delicate neck. She had a calming presence, and her arrival always seemed to bring with it a soft, gentle snowfall that coated the forest in a magical, sparkling blanket.

pages.title: Bradford
pages.text:
[[File:S-l400-4.jpg|thumb]]
Bradford, a red plaid bird who looked like he had stepped out of a classic winter postcard. His gray tweed newsie hat and green scarf with red tassels gave him a dapper appearance, and the wooden buttons on his belly added a touch of rustic charm. Bradford was the storyteller of the group, often gathering the younger birds around the fire to share tales of winters past. His deep, soothing voice and animated expressions made every story come alive, captivating his audience as they imagined the snowy scenes he described.

pages.title: Briggs
pages.text:
[[File:S-l400-5.jpg|thumb]]
Briggs, a black, white, and red plaid bird, was always bundled up in his knit red hat and matching scarf with green tassels. He had a warm and comforting presence, always ready to lend a wing to a friend in need. Briggs was particularly close to Trapper, the shy bird from the previous year. The two of them often spent quiet afternoons together, sharing stories and enjoying the peace of the forest. Briggs' easygoing nature made him a beloved member of the group, and his friends appreciated his quiet strength.

pages.title: Bucky
pages.text:
[[File:S-l1600.webp|thumb]]
Bucky, a brown bird with a playful spirit. What made Bucky special were the tiny antlers perched on his head, making him look like a miniature reindeer. To add a touch of elegance, he wore a sky blue bowtie that stood out against his warm brown feathers. Bucky loved to play in the snow and often led the other birds in games of hide-and-seek among the trees, his antlers bobbing as he flitted from branch to branch. This also made him the best at blending in with the surrounding.

pages.title: Camper
pages.text:
[[File:S-l400-3.jpg|thumb]]
Then there was Camper, a green bird who always seemed ready for an adventure. He was always prepared to sleep out in the forest as he carried his mat on his back. He sported a red trapper hat that covered his ears and a golden bandana tied snugly around his neck. Camper loved exploring the forest, especially during the quiet winter nights when the stars twinkled overhead. He was the storyteller of the group, always ready to share tales of his latest escapades by the warmth of a crackling fire.

pages.title: Clipper (Christmas 2016)
pages.text:
[[File:S-l1600-1.webp|thumb]]
Clipper, a grey bird with a love for crafting, was next to join. She arrived with a white knit hat and a matching scarf, both of which she had knitted herself. Clipper was always busy with her knitting needles, creating cozy garments for the other birds to wear. She had a gentle, nurturing nature and was often found helping her friends stay warm and comfortable during the cold winter nights.

== Fan Lore ==

Clove is a white and cream bird with an eye for cozy, handmade attire. Her white and gray patterned hat with ear flaps and a light gray scarf with pom-poms make her the go-to bird for warmth in the forest. Clove loves knitting by the fire, often gifting her friends with custom scarves and sweaters to keep them snug through the cold months.

pages.title: Cornice
pages.text:
[[File:Cornice.jpg|thumb]]

== Fan Lore ==

Cornice is next in line to take over Santa’s duties, but for now, he’s content wearing his Santa vest while he learns the ropes. His resemblance to Santa is uncanny, from his rosy cheeks to his red attire, but he hasn’t yet earned the full suit. Cornice is diligent and hardworking, often found assisting Klaus in organizing the holiday preparations. With his sights set on the future, he’s training to one day take on the big role of Christmas cheer-spreader.

pages.title: Dawkins
pages.text:
[[File:Dawkins.jpg|thumb]]

== Fan Lore ==

Dawkins, the black and white buffalo plaid bird, is a picture of sophistication. With his red wings, red scarf, and stylish black top hat adorned with a red ribbon and holly, Dawkins is always dressed to impress. His red glasses add to his intellectual air, making him the bird to consult for holiday etiquette and wisdom.

pages.title: Dazzle
pages.text:
[[File:Dazzle.jpg|thumb]]

== Fan Lore ==

Dazzle, much like Parker, prefers the casual comfort of a hoodie. This red bird is always seen in her green hoodie with white fur accents. She brings a laid-back energy to the group, balancing out the more formal attire of her peers. Dazzle’s playful personality is a hit among the younger birds, and her warmth makes her beloved in the forest.

pages.title: Deckard
pages.text:
[[File:Deckard.jpg|thumb]]

== Fan Lore ==

Deckard is always in the spirit of Christmas—literally! Dressed in a Christmas tree costume complete with a silver star and lights, Deckard is the living embodiment of holiday décor. His festive outfit brightens any gathering, and he loves standing in the center of holiday parties, being the “tree” for everyone to admire.

pages.title: Digby
pages.text:
[[File:S-l400-6.jpg|thumb]]
Digby was a gray bird, noticeably smaller than the others, but what he lacked in size, he made up for in spirit. He wore an oversized fancy red knit sweater and an equally oversized green hat with ear flaps and a white pom-pom at the top. Despite his small stature, Digby had a big heart and an adventurous spirit. He often teamed up with Kicker, the snowman bird, to take on fun challenges, like building the tallest snowman or finding the most colorful berries. Digby's enthusiasm and determination inspired everyone around him, proving that size didn’t matter when it came to making a big impact.

pages.title: Flurry (Christmas 2016)
pages.text:
[[File:S-l12001.webp|thumb]]
Flurry, a bird who seemed to be made of snow and wind. Flurry shared a close bond with Blizzard, as they both wore the same brown fur scarf, but Flurry also had her own white knit hat, that Clipper knitted for her. Flurry was full of energy, always flitting about and bringing a lively spirit to the group. She loved to dance in the snowflakes, her white feathers blending in with the wintry landscape as she twirled and soared through the air.

pages.title: Forrest
pages.text:
[[File:S-l1200-2.webp|thumb]]
Forrest was a serene and thoughtful white bird who found peace in the beauty of nature. He wore a white peacoat lined with gray fur and a blue knit scarf, perfectly blending into the snowy landscape he adored. Forrest enjoyed quiet walks through the forest, taking in the calm and tranquility of his surroundings. His deep appreciation for the natural world made him a source of wisdom and guidance for his friends, who often joined him on his peaceful strolls.

== Fan Lore ==

Frost is a master of blending in with his surroundings. With his white body, white trapper hat, light gray scarf, and matching feet, he can disappear into a snowy landscape without a trace. The only thing that gives him away is his bright orange beak. Frost is calm and collected, often slipping through the snow undetected. Despite his quiet nature, his ability to stay hidden makes him the perfect guardian of the forest, keeping an eye on everyone without them even knowing.

== Controversy ==

Many fans reacted negatively to the birds having mouths, which were also featured in the [[Halloween 2019 Releases|Halloween 2019 collection]]. In nature, birds' mouths are part of their [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beak beak], so it would make no sense for them to have an additional mouth below it. However, the mouths may be intended to mimic face paint as part of a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Halloween_costume costume]. If one is very bothered by the mouths or feels that they detract from the birds' cuteness, it is possible to remove them with tweezers, scissors, or similar craft tools.

pages.title: Hansy
pages.text:
[[File:S-l1200-4.jpg|thumb]]
Hansy was the epitome of class and charm, always impeccably dressed in his black wide-brimmed hat with a red ribbon, houndstooth shirt, red pants with suspenders, and an orange plaid scarf. Hansy loved to host elegant gatherings, where he would share his knowledge of fashion and proper etiquette. His dapper appearance and gentlemanly manners made him a respected figure in the forest, where he was always ready to offer a compliment or a kind word.

pages.title: How to Contribute to the Target Birds Wiki
pages.text: == Introduction == Hello! Welcome to the Target Bird Wiki, and thank you for helping to contribute to this community. This community is owned by and managed by all and is maintained by community members who edit the Wiki and is intended to be a living Wiki that is updated with new information and releases. Please read this guide before editing and creating new pages. == How to Contribute to the Wiki == # Create new Target Bird, Target Mini Bird, and Accessory pages that do not currently exist and are stubbed out in the [[All Releases|All Releases page]] as a non-linked item in the list. # Add information to preexisting pages. This can include new photos, new information, and linking to other pages. # Edit existing pages to better fit the style guidelines. == Editing the Wiki == === Adding a New Page === # In any page of the Target Bird Wiki, click the "triple dot" button at the top right of the screen. # Select "add page". # Type the name of the page in the text box. # Click the confirm button. # Save the page. === Adding a New Bird === # Create a new page with the name of the bird. # Add a front-facing photo (ideally a Target stock image) of the bird using the "photo" button in the toolbar. # Select "Insert" -> "Template" in the top toolbar. # Type "Target Bird" in the search bar and select the "Target Bird" template. # Fill in the template with the information available. Note that the image name must be typed out in exactly the same way as the file name was originally written. You can see how to fill out the template at [[Template:Target Bird]]. # Add a gallery with all photos. (Look at [[Labird]] for an example.) It may be easier to use the source editor (click "visual editor" in the top right to switch to this) to do this. # Save the changes with the "Save" button on the lower right side of the screen. # After creating a new bird, link the page to the entry in the [[All Releases]] page, the [[Birds]] page, and the corresponding collection, holiday/season, and year pages. Birds should be listed in alphabetical order within each section on these pages. === Editing a Page === # Navigate to the page that you wish to edit. # Click the pencil style edit button to edit the page or section that you wish to edit. # Make the desired changes. # Click the "Save" button on the lower right side of the screen. '''Note''': Please add any fan lore under a "Fan Lore" header. === Formatting Links === # Use double square brackets to link to pages or images within the Target Birds wiki. # For example, [[Target Birds Wiki]] creates a link to the front page like this: [[Target Birds Wiki]]. # You can use a pipe symbol | to make the link display different text than the name of the page: [[Target Birds Wiki|front page]] turns into [[Target Birds Wiki|front page]]. # You may see some links styled as [[w:c:target-birds:Target Birds Wiki|front page]]. They will also work, but the "w:c:target-birds:" part is unnecessary. (This syntax can be used to link to other Fandom wikis.) # [[Bloom.png]] creates a thumbnail of that image. # You can see more about formatting with wikitext at [[w:c:community:Help:Wikitext|Help:Wikitext]]. == Style Guidelines == Creating new pages and editing existing pages to fit style guidelines allows the Target Bird Wiki to be more cohesive and useful for Wiki users. Below are some guidelines for style. # Name Target Bird pages after the name of the Target Bird that is on its left leg unless the bird is unnamed. # Use gender neutral language about the birds. (Example: They/them/it) Target has not released official gender of any of the birds. # If there are birds with duplicate names, add parentheses at the end of the bird name with the collection of the bird. (Example: [[Radley (Valentine's Day 2022)]]) # Use the front-facing Target stock image for the main photo for each bird if available. If one is not available, try to find an image of the bird that is front facing with a light background. == Templates == * [[Template:Target Bird|Target Bird Template]] * [[Template:Target Mini Bird|Target Mini Bird Template]] * [[Template:Target Bird Set|Target Bird Set Template]] * [[Template:Target Bird Accessory|Target Bird Accessory Template]] * [[Template:Target Bird Ornament|Target Bird Ornament Template]] * [[Template:Target Bird Merch|Target Bird Merch Template]]

pages.title: Isley
pages.text:
[[File:S-l1200-5.jpg|thumb]]
Isley was a white bird known for her incredible knitting skills. She wore a fancy white knit hat with ear flaps and pom-poms, along with a matching sweater and a handmade scarf. Isley's love for knitting was matched only by her generosity; she often gifted her friends with warm accessories she had crafted herself. Her kind and nurturing nature made her the heart of the forest community, where she spent her days creating beautiful garments and teaching others the art of knitting.

pages.title: Juniper (Christmas 2018)
pages.text:
[[File:S-l1.jpg|thumb]]
Juniper was an adventurous white bird who loved to explore the hidden corners of the forest. Dressed in a green knit hat with a white knot on top, a white scarf, and a light gray knit sweater, Juniper was always prepared for his next journey. His curiosity and love for discovery led him on many exciting adventures, often with his friends in tow. Juniper’s stories of his explorations kept everyone entertained during the long winter nights.

pages.title: Kicker
pages.text:
[[File:S-l400-7.jpg|thumb]]
Kicker was another snowman bird, similar to Roller but with his own unique style. He wore a light blue and white striped hat with a red knot on the end, and a long, skinny red knit scarf. Kicker was always in the mood for fun, whether it was starting a snowball fight or sliding down the snowy hills. His playful energy was contagious, and he quickly became a favorite among the younger birds. Kicker and Roller often teamed up to create snow sculptures that amazed everyone, turning the forest into a winter wonderland filled with their creations.

pages.title: Klaus
pages.text:
[[File:Klaus.jpg|thumb]]

== Fan Lore ==

Klaus is the embodiment of Christmas. With his grand white beard and mustache, and his perfect red suit trimmed with the softest white fur, he is the Santa bird everyone looks up to. Even his ankles are wrapped in white fur, adding a touch of elegance to his festive appearance. Klaus spreads joy and warmth wherever he goes, leading the Christmas birds in their holiday cheer and making sure every detail of the season is perfect. His heart is as big as his presence, and he’s adored by all.

pages.text:

== Fan Lore ==

Langdale is a black bird with red antlers and a belt around his neck, giving him the appearance of a reindeer. His stoic nature contrasts with his festive look, making him a bit of an enigma in the forest. Despite his quiet demeanor, Langdale helps guide the birds during snowy nights, using his "reindeer" instincts.

pages.title: Maus
pages.text:
[[File:Il fullxfull.5677370034 cfe0.webp|thumb]]
Maus was a green plaid bird with a red belly, known for his appreciation of the simple pleasures in life. He wore an old red ball cap and a black knit scarf, embodying a classic winter look. Maus enjoyed the traditions of the season, from decorating the forest to sharing stories by the fire. His calm and steady presence was a comforting influence on his friends, who admired his dedication to keeping the old ways alive.

This bird has a tag on its left leg that says "Mikkel" on one side and "2020" on the other.

== Fan Lore ==

Mikkel is a delightful little tin soldier bird, dressed in a green uniform with red buttoned shirt and gold accents. His circular navy hat with gold trimmings adds to his military charm. Mikkel’s long white beard and wind-up key on his back give him an old-fashioned toy-like appearance, and he’s known for marching around the forest in perfect formation. Despite his mechanical look, Mikkel is full of energy and always ready for fun, leading the other birds in holiday parades.

pages.title: Nieva
pages.text:
[[File:S-l1200-6.jpg|thumb]]
Nieva was a tiny turquoise bird who loved to play in the snow. Her light blue and white striped hat, tied around her chin with a fuzzy pom-pom on top, and her sky blue puffer vest made her look like a little snowball herself. Nieva’s playful spirit brought joy to the forest, where she could often be found sliding down snowbanks or building snow forts. Her infectious laughter and bright colors made her a favorite among the younger birds.

== Fan Lore ==
Noelle was a light gray bird with a red belly, known for her love of caroling and spreading holiday cheer. She wore pink earmuffs and a matching scarf, perfectly suited for her festive nature. Noelle organized the annual caroling events, where she led the birds in singing joyful songs throughout the forest. Her sweet voice and kind heart made her the embodiment of Christmas spirit, bringing warmth and happiness to everyone she met.

pages.title: Parker
pages.text:
[[File:2017-Target-Wondershop-FEATHERLY-FRIENDS-Bird-PARKER-NWT.webp|thumb]]
Parker was a green bird with candy cane-striped feet and legs, dressed in a red hoodie with the hood pulled up over his head. The white pom-pom on the tip of his hood bobbed as he moved, and the front pocket of his hoodie was perfect for carrying small trinkets he found on his solitary walks. Parker enjoyed his space, often spending time alone, but he was never far from the group. His friends understood his need for quiet moments and never pressured him to join in the festivities unless he felt like it. Parker found comfort in the knowledge that, even though he liked to be alone, he was never truly lonely in Evergreen Forest.

pages.title: Peary
pages.text:
[[File:S-l400-10.jpg|thumb]]

== Fan Lore ==

Peary was a lime green bird with a flair for the unconventional. His lime green and white striped shirt, tweed blue vest, and blue hat with a white fuzzy pom-pom reflected his quirky personality. Peary also wore a braided light blue scarf with three pom-poms in yellow, light blue, and pink, adding a whimsical touch to his outfit. Known for his creativity, Peary enjoyed making unique decorations and sharing his artistic talents with his friends.

pages.title: Pepper
pages.text:
[[File:Pepper.webp|thumb]]

== Fan Lore ==

Pepper, with her tan tweed body and gray fur hat and scarf, has the flair of a Russian aristocrat. Her style is sophisticated, and she enjoys long walks in the snow, pondering the mysteries of the forest. Pepper is known for hosting elegant winter dinners where the birds discuss poetry and philosophy.

{{Target Bird|image1=[[Pere.jpg]]|caption-image1=A bird dressed as a reindeer.|target.com_title=Bird with Reindeer Ears Decorative Figurine - Wondershop™|target.com_description=Your holiday display will get a whimsical update when you add the Bird with Reindeer Ears Decorative Figurine from Wondershop™. This adorable figurine is styled to look like a sweet little bird all dressed for the holiday season, complete with a green striped scarf and a pair of glittery reindeer antlers. The bird figurine is made from durable materials so you can enjoy it season after season, and at a height of seven inches, it's perfect for adding to a wide variety of holiday displays, from tabletop and credenza arrangements to festive mantel tableaus and more.|color=Red, white, blue, green, gold|type=[[Birds|Bird]]|collection=[[Christmas 2020 Releases|Christmas 2020]]|holiday/season=[[Christmas Releases|Christmas]]|year=[[2020 Releases|2020]]}}
This bird has a tag on its left leg that says "Pere" on one side and "2020" on the other.

== Fan Lore ==

Pere is the life of every holiday party. A red bird with a flair for festive fashion, she’s always dressed to impress in her dark and light green striped scarf. But it’s her sparkly reindeer antlers that really steal the show. Pere loves to dance and sing carols, bringing a lively energy to any gathering. Whether she’s decorating trees or leading the others in holiday games, Pere’s enthusiasm and sense of fun make her a favorite among the Christmas birds.

pages.title: Pink Christmas 2023 Mini
Piper
pages.text:
[[File:S-l120.jpg|thumb]]
Piper was a light blue bird who brought a touch of modern style to the group with her metallic puffer coat and white fur-lined hood. She had a vibrant personality that matched her shiny appearance, and she loved adding a bit of sparkle to everything she did. Piper had a knack for decorating, often helping Tinker and the others make the forest look its best for the holiday season. Her keen eye for detail and her love of all things bright made her a natural at creating beautiful displays that dazzled the entire forest.

pages.title: Piton
pages.text:
[[File:Piton.jpg|thumb]]

== Fan Lore ==

Piton is always ready for an adventure. This light blue bird loves nothing more than exploring the forest and mountains, no matter how cold it gets. Dressed in his olive green canvas jacket lined with fur and his signature yellow trapper hat, Piton always has his red backpack packed and ready for any hike. He’s the go-to guide for exploring new trails, and his love for the outdoors is infectious, often leading others on exciting journeys through the snowy wilderness.

Designed by artist Dia Pacheco, it'll make a fun pairing with other Dia de Muertos figurines.

Guest Artist Dia Pacheco is a graphic designer by career but a freelance illustrator by profession. She comes from the city of Chihuahua and currently lives in Mérida, Yucatán, Mexico.|color=Orange, green, purple, yellow, pink|type=[[Birds|Bird]]|collection=[[Dia de los Muertos 2024 Releases|Dia de los Muertos 2024]]|holiday/season=[[Dia de los Muertos Releases|Dia de los Muertos]]|year=[[2024 Releases|2024]]|release_date=October 2024|caption-image1=A bird dressed as a calavera.|title1=Pixán}}This bird has a tag on its left leg that says "Pixán" on one side and "2024" on the other. It was designed by Mexican artist Dia Pacheco.

While the online listing says the bird's name is "Lindoro," the actual tag says "Pixán." "Pixán" is Mayan for "soul,"  while "lindoro" is Spanish for "one who receives special treatment."

This bird has a gold tag on its left foot that says "Powell" on one side and "2020" on the other.

In 2024, it was rereleased as part of the [[10pc Featherly Friends™ 2024 Reunion Collection Christmas Bird Figurine Set - Wondershop™|2024 Reunion Collection]]. This version has a tag on its left leg that says "Powell" on one side and "2024 Reunion" on the other, as well as gold stitching on the underside of its body that says "Hatched 2020."

== Fan Lore ==

Powell is a lime green bird with a passion for skiing. Whether it's the slopes of the forest or a powdery mountain peak, you can find him zipping down on his skis, leaving trails of snow behind. To show his Christmas spirit, Powell wears a festive Santa hat, paired with his favorite teal scarf and a white puff coat to keep him warm. His love for skiing is matched only by his love for adventure, and he’s always encouraging his friends to hit the slopes with him. For Powell, the best part of winter is the thrill of the ride.

== Fan Lore ==

Primrose is a bird who loves the cold, but even more so, she loves the color gray. Everything about her, from her hat to her scarf and sweater, is millennial gray. Her fashion sense is impeccable, and she’s always the most stylish bird in the forest, even when temperatures drop. Primrose is calm, composed, and elegant, and her love for winter is matched only by her love for fashion. She’s often found strolling through the snow, looking as chic as ever in her gray ensemble.

pages.title: Quincy
pages.text:
[[File:S-l12.jpg|thumb]]
Quincy was a green bird with a scholarly air about him, thanks to his brown tweed jacket with wooden buttons, white shirt with a collar, and a red trapper hat with a pom-pom on top. His gold glasses and red plaid bowtie completed his distinguished look. Quincy was the thinker of the group, always pondering new ideas and sharing interesting facts about the forest and the world beyond. He often found himself deep in conversation with Blizzard and Glacier, discussing the mysteries of the winter season. Quincy's wisdom and curiosity made him a respected member of the flock, and his friends often sought his advice when they needed guidance.

== Fan Lore ==

Rocky, Powell’s best friend, shares his love for the snowy mountains but prefers a snowboard over skis. This light blue bird is always ready for the next ride down the mountain, dressed in his navy blue beanie and forest green scarf to keep him cozy. He sports a red buffalo plaid shirt with a red puffer vest over it, completing his rugged snowboarding look. Rocky is fearless and loves the rush of carving through the snow, often racing Powell to see who can reach the bottom first. Together, they’re the ultimate snow duo.

pages.title: Roller
pages.text:
[[File:S-l400-2.jpg|thumb]]
Roller was a playful addition to the group, resembling a tiny snowman with his round white body adorned with black buttons. He wore a blue hat with a matching ribbon and a red scarf with blue tassels. Roller was always up for a bit of fun, often rolling around in the snow and making the other birds laugh with his antics. His cheerful personality made him a favorite among the younger creatures in the forest, who loved to follow him around and join in his games.

pages.title: Rose
pages.text:
[[File:M wp 6574b6aec9a2286453616d0e.webp|thumb]]

== Fan Lore ==

Rose was a light pink bird with silky feathers and a love for all things luxurious. She wore a sparkly gold scarf that shimmered in the winter light, complementing her perfectly groomed, fuzzy wings. Rose was the most glamorous bird in the forest, always attending events in style and setting trends with her impeccable fashion sense. Her love for the finer things in life didn’t stop her from being a caring and supportive friend, always ready to offer advice or a helping wing.

Rowan is a bird who appreciates simplicity. With his forest green hat, burgundy sweater, and gray scarf, he doesn’t seek attention, but his calm, steady presence is always appreciated. Rowan enjoys quiet moments by the fire, reading or knitting while the others bustle about with their festivities.

pages.title: Schatzi
pages.text:
[[File:S-l400-11.jpg|thumb]]

== Fan Lore ==

Schatzi was a black and white bird with a practical nature, always busy preparing for the winter season. He wore a light brown hat with a red pom-pom and a red knit scarf, often seen carrying a small tree on his back. Schatzi’s dedication to his work ensured that the forest was well-prepared for the cold months, and his resourcefulness made him an essential part of the community. His hard work and reliability were appreciated by all who knew him.

pages.title: Scout
pages.text:
[[File:S-l1600-2.webp|thumb]]
Scout, the adventurous brother of Camper, joined the flock with his explorer’s spirit. Like Camper, he wore a red trapper hat, but he also sported a tweed scarf and a buffalo plaid jacket that gave him a rugged, outdoorsy look. Scout was never without his cantina, ready for any emergency during their winter explorations. He and Camper were inseparable, often leading the group on exciting adventures through the snow-covered woods, discovering hidden wonders and sharing stories around the campfire.

pages.title: Sierra
pages.text:
[[File:S-l400-8.jpg|thumb]]
Sierra, a white bird with an oversized white knit hat and a brown fur scarf, was all about staying warm and cozy. Her hat had a large brown fur pom-pom on top, and she always looked snug and stylish. Sierra loved knitting, much like Clipper, and the two of them often worked together to create beautiful, warm garments for the rest of the flock. Sierra's caring nature and her love for all things cozy made her a kind-hearted presence in the forest, always ready to share a warm scarf or a kind word with a friend in need.

Snoozer
pages.text:
[[File:S-l400-9.jpg|thumb]]
Snoozer was a red bird who was always ready to curl up and take a nap. He wore red and white striped pajamas with green buttons and a matching sleeping cap that drooped over his eyes. Snoozer's love for sleep was legendary, and he was often found snuggled up in the coziest spots of the forest, dreaming of Christmas feasts and snowy adventures. Despite his sleepy nature, Snoozer was always there when it counted, lending a hand (or a wing) when the holiday preparations required it. His friends knew that, while he might be a little slow to wake up, Snoozer's heart was always in the right place.

Standing atop two webbed feet, you can place it on its own or in an arrangement with other Christmas figurines or trees on your mantel, windowsills, foyer table or shelves for a splendid display.|color=White, gray|type=[[Birds|Bird]]|collection=[[Christmas 2020 Releases|Christmas 2020]]|holiday/season=[[Christmas Releases|Christmas]]|year=[[2020 Releases|2020]]}}

== Fan Lore ==

Sorrel, with her elegant white knit hat and matching fur scarf, sees herself as the princess of the forest. Accented with touches of light gray, she moves gracefully through the snow, expecting everyone to admire her regal appearance. Sorrel is Frost’s sister, though she can never quite understand why he chooses to blend in when they could both be shining stars. She takes great pride in her appearance and enjoys the finer things in life, often found perched high up in the trees, surveying her wintery domain.

== Fan Lore ==

Spruce is a light gray bird who is always cold, no matter how many layers he wears. His forest green peacoat with a hood cinched all the way up keeps him bundled tightly. Spruce loves the winter, but he’s always found next to a fire, sipping hot cocoa to stay warm.

pages.title: Tahoe
pages.text:
[[File:$ 1.png|thumb]]
Tahoe was a white bird who loved everything about winter. She wore a white knit hat and sweater, both lined with brown fur, and a green knit scarf. Tahoe was always the first to suggest a snowball fight or a sledding adventure, her enthusiasm for the cold season infectious. She and Aspen often teamed up to explore the winter landscape, finding the best spots for snow games and winter fun. Tahoe's boundless energy and love for the season made her a joy to be around, and she brought a sense of excitement to the forest that kept everyone in high spirits.

pages.title: Tanner
Target Birds
pages.text:
Target Birds, also known as Featherly Friends or seasonal fabric birds, are small decorative bird figurines sold by [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Target_Corporation Target]. They are made of styrofoam and fabric and usually stand 6-8 inches tall and weigh 30-50 grams. <ref>{{Cite web | title=Día de Muertos Featherly Friends Sugar Skull Bird Decorative Figurine | publisher=Target.com | date=September 12, 2021 | url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210912123033/https://www.target.com/p/d-237-a-de-muertos-featherly-friends-sugar-skull-bird-decorative-figurine-designed-with-luis-fitch/-/A-81452308?fbclid=IwAR1kmv4tvwCYm50FILF7qO1MYnyP0HktxeqtnSYX7f9ZI0zTj1NQ3STMKPU}}</ref> <ref>{{Cite web | title=Featherly Friends Harvest Bird with Glasses Decorative Figurine | publisher=Target.com | date=September 14, 2021 | url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210914192043/https://www.target.com/p/featherly-friends-harvest-bird-with-glasses-decorative-figurine-hyde-38-eek-boutique-8482/-/A-81213542}}</ref> <ref>{{Cite web | title=Featherly Friends Easter Fabric Bird Bunny | publisher=Target.com | date=February 20, 2021 | url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210220215357/https://www.target.com/p/featherly-friends-easter-fabric-bird-bunny-spritz-8482/-/A-79811526}}</ref> Most birds have a similar body shape with a round body, thin legs, short tail, beady eyes, and small beak. Each bird has a unique, seasonal outfit. For example, Halloween birds may be dressed in a Halloween costume. Most birds also have a gold nametag on their left foot displaying the name of the bird and the year it was released. Birds are released several times a year with seasonal themes: [[Valentine's Day Releases|Valentine's Day]], [[Saint Patrick's Day Releases|St. Patrick's Day]], [[Easter Releases|Easter]], [[Pride Releases|Pride]], [[Sun Squad Releases|summer]], [[Halloween Releases|Halloween]], [[Dia de los Muertos Releases|Día de los Muertos]], [[Harvest Releases|harvest]], and [[Christmas Releases|winter and Christmas]]. They may be branded as Spritz, Sun Squad, Hyde & Eek! Boutique, or Wondershop. As of 2024, they retail for $5 USD. Similar birds can be found at other stores such as Walmart and T.J. Maxx.

The birds have become popular as collectible items since their creation in 2012, sometimes reselling at a large markup. <ref>{{Cite web | title=Why Are People Obsessed with the Target Birds? | publisher=The Spruce | date=February 18, 2022 | url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220528142624/https://www.thespruce.com/target-bird-obsession-5218918}}</ref> <ref>{{Cite web | title=These Tiny $5 Birds Are Causing a Frenzy at Target — Here’s Why | publisher=Apartment Therapy | date=November 7, 2022 | url=https://www.apartmenttherapy.com/target-featherly-friends-37180573}}</ref> <ref>{{Cite web | title=‘The Stress Is Palpable.’ The Frenzy Over Target’s $5 Birds | publisher=Wall Street Journal | date=August 19, 2024  | url=https://www.wsj.com/style/fashion/target-birds-halloween-decorations-collectors-0171442b}}</ref>

pages.title: Tinker
pages.text:
[[File:S-l400.jpg|thumb]]
Tinker, a cheerful green bird with a yellow belly, was the group’s very own Christmas elf. He wore a green hat with a white pom-pom on the end and a yellow band. His white collar made him look official and ready for holiday duties. Tinker was full of energy, always busy helping with the preparations and making sure everything was just right for Christmas. His infectious enthusiasm and attention to detail ensured that every decoration was perfectly placed, and every gift was wrapped with care.

pages.text:

== Fan Lore ==

Toby was a red and white plaid bird with a green scarf, known for his easygoing and friendly personality. He loved spending time with his friends, whether it was helping with holiday preparations or simply enjoying the snowy landscape. Toby’s warm and welcoming nature made him a beloved figure in the forest, where he was always ready to sled down any big hill with a friend.

pages.title: Trapper (Christmas 2016)
pages.text:
[[File:P0.jpg|thumb]]
Trapper, a bird with a unique plaid pattern of blue, red, and yellow. He wore a red knit hat and a green knit scarf, which kept him warm as he quietly observed the bustling activities around him. Trapper was a bit shy compared to the others, often staying on the sidelines, but he was always there when his friends needed him. His calm, gentle nature brought balance to the lively group, and over time, he grew more confident, finding his own special place in the Christmas celebrations.

pages.title: Whistler
pages.text:
[[File:M wp 64fd081f678c3a843a94b929.webp|thumb]]
Whistler, a bird with a talent for music. Dressed in a brown fur trapper hat, a brown fur scarf, and a white and silver knit sweater, Whistler was always humming or whistling a tune. Her beautiful melodies could be heard throughout the forest, bringing a sense of peace and joy to all who listened. Whistler's musical talents added a special touch to the holiday celebrations, her songs filling the air with the magic of Christmas. Whether she was leading a carol or simply whistling a cheerful tune, Whistler's music was the heart and soul of the Christmas birds' festivities.

pages.title: Yarrow
pages.text:
[[File:Yarrow.jpg|thumb]]

== Fan Lore ==

Yarrow is a pink bird with fluffy white wings and a flair for sparkle. With her silver earmuffs and cream scarf, she’s always looking for ways to add glitter to her outfits. Yarrow brings a touch of glamour to the forest, and she’s often found decorating the trees with her signature sparkle.

pages.text:
{{Target Bird|image1=Yule.jpg|caption-image1=A bird dressed as a Christmas tree with a star on top.|target.com_title=Bird with Christmas Tree Decorative Figurine - Wondershop™|target.com_description=The Bird with Christmas Tree Decorative Figurine from Wondershop™ adds a playful touch to your traditional holiday display. This adorable figurine is styled to look like a sweet little bird dressed up as a Christmas tree, complete with felt ornaments and a bright yellow star on top of the bird's little head. The bird figurine is made from durable materials so you can enjoy it season after season, and at a height of seven inches, it's perfect for adding to a wide variety of holiday displays, from tabletop and credenza arrangements to festive mantel tableaus and more.|color=Green, yellow, red, blue|type=[[Birds|Bird]]|collection=[[Christmas 2020 Releases|Christmas 2020]]|holiday/season=[[Christmas Releases|Christmas]]|year=[[2020 Releases|2020]]}}
This bird has a tag on their left leg that says "Yule" on one side and "2020" on the other.
== Fan Lore ==

Yule is perhaps the most festive of all the Christmas birds, as he quite literally transforms into a Christmas tree. His entire body is wrapped in evergreen branches, with large, colorful ornaments hanging from his feathers. A sparkly gold and yellow star sits proudly atop his head, completing his tree-like appearance. Yule’s cheerful personality shines just as brightly as his decorations, and he’s always the center of attention during holiday gatherings. Wherever Yule goes, he brings the joy and magic of Christmas with him.

== Fan Lore ==

Zinny was a cream-colored bird with textured feathers and very fluffy wings, always dressed in her favorite rose pink sparkly scarf. As Rose’s best friend, Zinny shared her love for glamour and elegance, often attending parties and events with her. Zinny’s charming and sophisticated demeanor made her a delight to be around, and her keen sense of style ensured that she was always the best-dressed bird in the forest.
